passages.original: Sermones de Sanctis.—Secundus sermonum, quos vocant ne Sanctis, apud AUgustinum atque Maximum editus fuit : sed hulc ant non solum dictio, verum etiam cum qninquagesimo octavo affinitas illum asserit.
passages.english: Sermons on the Saints. The second of the sermons which they call "on the Saints" was published among [the works of] Augustine and Maximus; but not only the style, but also its affinity with the fifty-eighth [sermon], claims it for this [author].
passages.notes: Scanning errors corrected: "ne Sanctis" read as "de Sanctis", "AUgustinum" as "Augustinum", "qninquagesimo" as "quinquagesimo". "hulc ant" is garbled; read as "huic" ("for this [author]", i.e. Ambrose), with "ant" possibly a stray fragment. This reading is uncertain. The passage appears to be an editor's note on attribution, not text by Ambrose himself.

passages.original: Enarratio in caput XXXI Proverbiorum apud Augustinum, cui ascribitur, pura legi potest, ac sine illie additamentis, quae ut magis Ambrosiana judicaretur, eidem intexuit Romana editio.
passages.english: The Exposition of chapter 31 of Proverbs, [found] among [the works of] Augustine, to whom it is ascribed, can be read in its pure form and without those additions which the Roman edition wove into it so that it would be judged more Ambrosian.
passages.notes: "illie" read as "illis". This is an editorial note on attribution.
